source: Window functions compute a value across related rows and retain individual rows. GROUP BY collapses rows into groups.
expected: Window functions retain individual rows instead of collapsing them.

source: Parameterized queries bind user input as data. Concatenating untrusted input into SQL can enable SQL injection. Escaping alone is not the preferred defense.
expected: Use parameterized queries to bind user input as data.

source: Hash table lookup is O(1) on average and O(n) in the worst case. An average bound is not a worst-case guarantee.
expected: Hash lookup is O(1) on average, but O(n) in the worst case.
